soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 / Theorem 2
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted witness is not in the order-s Hölder class for s>1: g_star crosses zero with nonzero derivative at x=1/2, so |g_star| and hence q_00,q_11,q_01,q_10 have a cusp there; thus the claimed inclusion W_n ⊆ P_n, on which the location barrier relies, is false as stated.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The main result establishes honesty of the bias-aware Anderson-Rubin confidence set under its maintained known-cutoff fuzzy-RD assumptions; it does not state the proposal's unknown-cutoff minimax expected-length frontier.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Introduction; Sections 2 and 4 as described on the journal page
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies an unknown discontinuity point, centers its main analysis on sharp RD, and states that cutoff estimation does not affect asymptotic treatment-effect efficiency in its fixed-discontinuity setting.

source_verification_receipts.version: Statistics and Probability Letters 34(4), 1997 journal version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies a smooth fixed-design regression model with one discontinuity, obtains O_p(n^-1) localization for a fixed jump and O_p(n^-1 Delta_n^-2) under a shrinking jump, with a two-sided Brownian triangular-drift limit.
The article concerns unknown-threshold RD, a white-noise correspondence, and minimax localization of a discontinuity in a derivative of the regression function.
The article derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear regression functionals over convex function classes, including an RD specialization.

The paper studies localization of multivariate piecewise-constant distribution changes with Lipschitz densities and provides information-theoretic localization lower bounds plus a near-minimax procedure.
The paper proposes the Bayesian LoTTA approach to account for unknown cutoff location in RD effect estimation; its abstract does not assert a frequentist honest minimax length frontier.
The paper separately discusses possible fuzzy-RDD and unknown-discontinuity extensions after its sharp-RD high-dimensional analysis, rather than deriving their joint weak-cutoff frontier.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the absolute-value outcome table with a globally smooth common table, for example choose a constant b>|g_star| and set q_01=(b+g_star)/2, q_10=(b-g_star)/2, and q_00=q_11=(1-b)/2; then recheck the common-outcome likelihood property.

Re-prove witness membership explicitly for every s in [1,2], including Hölder-radius constants for the product w_j,ell q_a,b, observable-cell positivity, and the exact likelihood-ratio calculation used in Theorem 2.

After a legal witness is established, solve the s=1 plateau critical experiment and give a computable limiting connected-length expression with an attaining interval, rather than only the current handle.

recommended_next_step: Return to Stage -1: repair the invalid smooth witness and rerun the proposal review before advancing any location-barrier or critical-window claim.
